pairs: I will praise the Lord with my life.
psallam Deo meo quamdiu fuero. Nolite confidere in principibus,
I will sing psalms to my God as long as I shall be. Do not trust in the leaders,
in whom there is no salvation.
and he will return to his earth.
in illa die peribunt omnes cogitationes eorum.
In that day, all their thoughts will perish.
Beatus cujus Deus Jacob adjutor ejus,
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob:
spes ejus in Domino Deo ipsius:
his hope is in the Lord God himself,
et omnia quæ in eis sunt.
and all the things that are in them.
He executes judgment for those who suffer injury.
He provides food for the hungry.
The Lord releases those who are bound.
The Lord sets upright those who have been thrown down.
The Lord watches over new arrivals.
He will support the orphan and the widow.
And he will destroy the ways of sinners.
